text_block_list.text:
I drop by the cafeteria, only to hear
what sounds
like a strange incantation.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Uma umya unya n-nyuma?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
You were so close this time! This is good
progress!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Umya una ubyaaa? Sigh... Not again... I keep mixing up the words.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer... There's going to be a vocal
exam in
one of my classes soon...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
But the song they're using for the test
has a
section that goes really fast... It's
very, very
difficult.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
That's what I'm here for, to accompany
her for
some practice!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Doto, let's give it another go, okay?
Uma uma
umya unya—3, 2, 1, fight!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Una numa ubya fight!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I really can't do this! I'm sorry for
bothering
you with my problems,
Fukukitaru!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Oh no, this is no bother at all. My daily
fortune
predicts a large helping of good
luck if I lend
someone a hand!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Also, have you forgotten our bond?
We're
partners in our eternal hunt for
lucky items!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ngh, thank you... But, I don't think any
more of
this will help much.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Is there anything I can do to improve my
singing?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: F-fun? But how?
choice_data_list: どうせなら楽しく練習しよう
根本的な解決策を探した方が……？
choice_data_list_en: We might as well make practice fun.
Shouldn't we look for a root solution...?

text_block_list.text:
Since the goal is to practice singing, I
invite the
two to karaoke.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Oooh, that's an amazing idea! Let's have

ourselves a blast—I mean, a great
practice
session!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Urgh... H-holding this microphone only
makes me
more nervous.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Hey, now. If singing alone is too scary,
let's do a
duet! Now, where's that
remote?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Oh yikes, we both screwed up a lot of
the lines!
This song is a tough one!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
But no one really cares so long as you
sound like
you're having fun! When you
smile, Fortune smiles
back!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ah, s-sorry. I g-got carried away after
seeing you
have so much fun,
Fukukitaru.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
No, no, it's good that you're relaxed!
Why not see
if this helps things? Three,
two, one, go!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Huh? Oh, um...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Uma uma umya unya—3, 2, 1, flight!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! That's the best one you've had
yet! Well
done to you, Doto!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ohh, thank you so much! It's all because
of your
help, Fukukitaru!

Her nerves melting away, Meisho Doto
breaks
into a smile. It looks like she has
built a strong
bond with the
good-natured Matikanefukukitaru.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: The root of the problem?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Hrmm, I see what you mean! Fixing one
line won't
fix the whole song, so this
calls for divine
intervention! C'mon,
Doto!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Huh? Huuuuh? W-wait a second!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Come now, Doto, join me in prayer! Pour
your
entire heart and soul into it. Leave
no detail
unspoken!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: My entire heart and soul?! Um, o-okay. I'm really nervous, so I might mess this up...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Unn—I mean—umm... Dear gods! Nngh, I
um... I'd
wike to pway... forood luck?!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
This is... no good... I can't pray properly
when I
get nervous!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Now, let's settle down, okay? Deep
breaths, deep
breaths. The gods are
patient, so you can take
your time!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Oh... Th-that's true... Breathe in... and
out...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, o mighty... g-gods. I would
like to sing
without slipping up on my
lines.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I said it!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Well done, Doto! Perhaps slowing down
could
help with your singing too?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Let's give it a go! Don't worry, the gods
are by
your side cheering you on!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Uma... Uma... Unya... Unya... Uma uma
unya
umya?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Whoa! You're nearly there!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Uma uma umya unya...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I d-did it!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
That was terrific! Great job, Doto! Now
we just
have to up the tempo one step
at a time!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Wooow... Thank you, gods! Thank you,

Fukukitaru!

Matikanefukukitaru sticks around until
the very
end of their practice. It seems
Meisho Doto has
been blessed with a
very good friend.
